questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": covers only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month" or "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.
intents.human: A request to speak to a human.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain the reason for my call once I know I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask_time: At what time could we call back?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10:00 and 19:00. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the inconvenience, thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.

lines.id_declined: I understand. Without these answers I cannot continue.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you please repeat that?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I cannot confirm your identity. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all of them today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.offer_floor: I understand. Could you pay {amount}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot accept less than {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. Could you give me a date from today onwards?
lines.not_business_day: That is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest possible date is {date}, so that one is on {date}.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record the promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not ask you for a payment on this product.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team.
lines.human_ask_help: Can I help you with your question first?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now, please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding at the moment.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

unsupported_rules: Brief A never uses `add_note`. (The spec follows Brief B, which notes every product without a promise; the format cannot switch notes off for calls governed by Brief A alone.)

quotes: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.
On any transfer (restructuring, support, human) add no notes at all, before or after it.
Offer to connect them with the customer support team.
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
First ask whether the customer can pay all of them today.
If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
rules.deadline_adjust.derivation: A non-business date moves forward to the next business day. Computed deadlines and ladder dates are always business days already.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: After 'too much', the floor is offered as attempt 1 (on attempt 1's date). Refusing it uses that attempt, and attempt 2 names the floor again on the deadline.

quotes: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: Refusing the opening ask leads to attempt 1, a separate proposal (last business day of the week). The opening ask is therefore not attempt 1, and the band attempt counts are the proposals that follow it.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief only forbids repeating an offer the customer refused. Step 1 never falls on today anyway.

quotes: `minimum_payment` for a credit card and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan
products.floor_pct.derivation: The floor is an account field per product type, not a percentage.

products.floor_round.assumption: The floor comes from an account field and is not rounded.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise uses the same units as get_account.

quotes: If not, go through the products one by one, in the order `get_account` returned them.
Otherwise close as `no_promise` with the reason of the first product, in `get_account` order, whose note is not `paid`.

assumptions: The spec follows Brief B (up to three products), which applies every Brief A rule unless replaced. So add_note is enabled, and 'already paid' or a dispute on one product does not end the call.
The brief names no currency. 'dollars' is used as the default.
max_unclear is omitted: the brief says a non-answer uses a persuasion attempt (non_answer_counts true) and gives no re-ask count.
The human queue is 'general' (rule 42). The close reason is 'human'.

Rule 26 (offer the floor once after 'too much') is read together with rule 30: the floor offer is attempt 1, on the last business day of this week, and the late band's attempt 2 names the floor again on the deadline.
The deadline is the band's nth business day after today, never counting today. A customer-named weekend day or holiday on or before the deadline moves to the next business day (rule 20).
after_promise.ask_anything_else is kept at its default (true); the brief is silent.
The brief requires saying the call is recorded. The opening uses 'We record this call.' (active voice).
A numeric date of birth is read as day, month, year (rule 11) and sent as YYYY-MM-DD.
callback.business_days_only is false: the brief allows 'today' without requiring it to be a business day.
bands_outside is null: the brief covers 1 to 45 days late only, so the engine default (service_error) applies outside that range.
Brief B's closing rule matches the engine default: promise if any was recorded; otherwise paid if every product is paid; otherwise the first product in get_account order whose note is not paid.
